subject.title: refactor(zalouser): compile blocks from CommonMark IR

question: Should parser-owned block/list metadata become a supported plugin-SDK contract, or should the shared SDK retain ownership and offer ZaloUser a narrower formatter capability instead?
rationale: The PR intentionally keeps metadata out of the public `MarkdownIR` type while a bundled plugin depends on it at runtime. That is a durable plugin-boundary decision, not a mechanical typing fix.

options.title: Expose a narrow SDK contract
options.body: Add an explicitly documented, tested plugin-SDK metadata capability whose serialized and compatibility behavior is clear to plugin consumers.

options.title: Keep metadata internal
options.body: Move the Zalo-specific structural compilation behind a shared SDK helper so the plugin consumes an intentional output contract rather than hidden parser details.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Keep the existing local scanner until maintainers choose the permanent cross-plugin Markdown ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Expose a narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Add an explicitly documented, tested plugin-SDK metadata capability whose serialized and compatibility behavior is clear to plugin consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: The current refactor series spans both sides of the proposed boundary, making this contributor the closest available routing candidate; ownership confidence remains low without local history.
